observations: The prior audit supplies no Accepted authority model and requires a separate preregistered campaign.

The frozen repository registers 59 proof artifacts across the base discovery pathways and three declared schema-aware extensions.
Three proof records self-register through proof_object_id, two through constrained canonical id fields, and two as proof-bearing keys of the declared historical_artifacts map.

The proof-object-id canonical-id and artifact-map rules are limited by declared roots JSON structure and applicable proof-bearing filename constraints; disabling each is detected by a dedicated negative control.
Proof paths must be collected before existence testing; object-valued paths, mapping keys, and terminal Lean entrypoints require explicit traversal.
The validator independently enforces the model header as Research, inactive, unpromoted, and canonically deferred; four mutations of those declarations were rejected.
The validator independently enforces a predating independent bootstrap authority, preregistration and hash locking, and the full frozen activation and promotion requirement sets.
The six A3 governing domains are fixed by the preregistered design; removing a domain from both the candidate declaration and owner map was detected for every domain.
A proof owner pattern alone does not establish status or authority-bearing designation.
The synthetic activation probe contained 59 artifact entries and 60 resolvable decision records and remained explicitly non-operative.

Manifest and entry decisions passed only when identity, version, governance authority, independence, artifact/status/designation linkage, decision date, supporting evidence, scope, limitations, manifest digest, and record digest all matched.
Two equal-priority contradictory claims with identical proposition identity fields adjudicated to Unknown.
For unequal priorities, the validator derived the order from the candidate model: lower numeric rank is higher authority, so priority 1 governance overrode priority 5 Research and produced Affirmed.
All 57 injected faults were executed and detected in both the primary and internal repeat runs.

Primary run 30519399225 at commit f916fe2b2e8e6cb02ad753e9114fa9adbb5fd186 and repeat run 30519531630 at commit bbaee75cf16dd76658ab97beac11e42ec22e266d validated identical final candidate and validator blobs and produced digest bec322a704c4f3932a716b3798f1cd9bd81136635e486ddc862eac38bdab53a0.
